title: 07. College: Endgame & Borders (17k–12k)
description: Seal open territory boundaries (Yose) before passing so the opponent cannot sneak into your corner.

puzzles.title: Seal the 2nd-Line Monkey Jump
puzzles.concept: Before passing at the end of a game, scan every border between Black and White walls. An open gap on the 1st or 2nd line lets the opponent slide deep into your territory.
puzzles.prompt: Late endgame: Black controls the left side and White controls the right, but one border gap remains open. Seal your territory before passing!

solutions.feedback: Clean border seal! D1 closes the 1st-line gate—if you had passed, White could have played D1 and C1 to erase 4+ points of your territory.
Strong endgame Hane! Pushing to E1 seals the border AND gains an extra point while forcing White to defend.

wrongHints.default: Follow the vertical wall down to the bottom edge—D2 and E2 end at the 2nd line, leaving the 1st-line gate (D1/E1) wide open!

puzzles.title: Defend the Cutting Dame
puzzles.concept: Never pass while one of your boundary stones has only 1 or 2 liberties next to an opponent's wall—connect your weak joint first.
puzzles.prompt: White threatens to push through your diagonal wall at E5. Connect the last boundary point so your entire left territory is watertight!

solutions.feedback: Watertight! D5 links your top and bottom walls into one solid border so White cannot cut into D4.
Strong block! E5 stops White's push and keeps your diagonal wall completely connected.

wrongHints.default: Look at the gap between E6 and D4—White is ready to wedge into E5/D5 and shatter your wall.
